answer: Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 184 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ferrous account. Deposits are visible in jade, and forge reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 35% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Every extra alias adds 15 hours of verification and 7 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
